notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: two sources, each a single line, and no history found. The Forest Lookouts page has only its header, forest and state. Two searches for a Lincoln NF Lookout Mountain returned other towers (Ruidoso, Monjeau, Weed) and nothing about this site. Other 'Lookout Mountain' sites (Cibola 35.21864, -108.27954; Sierra 33.35212, -107.82160) are different towers and were not used. The brief's coordinates and county match the FFLA list. Story is about 60 words, below the 120-word floor; kept short rather than padded.
